name: @w6w-apps/signwell
description: Send documents and templates out for e-signature with SignWell, track and remind recipients, run bulk sends, and fetch completed PDFs.

w6w.longDescription:
SignWell is an e-signature service, and this app covers its REST API for the full send-and-track loop. Create a document from a file URL or base64 content, or from one or more saved templates with the template's fields pre-filled; keep it as a draft or send it to its recipients, in a fixed signing order or all at once, by email or SMS, with a passcode if needed. Read a document back to see where each recipient stands, remind the ones who have not signed, correct a recipient's name or email, delete a document, and fetch a download link for the completed PDF (optionally with the audit page, or as a zip). Templates can be created, read, updated and deleted, and a template can be sent to many people at once through a bulk send built from a CSV. The account call returns who the key belongs to and what plan it is on, and webhooks can be listed, registered and removed so a workflow can react to signing events.

SignWell has one API host and one credential, an API key sent as the X-Api-Key header. Deliberately out of scope: the API application endpoints, authentication updates, bulk-send CSV helpers, and the Mexico NOM-151 certificate; and the completed-document download is always returned as a link, never as raw PDF bytes, because the sandbox has no place to put a binary body.
